definitions.ambiguous: decisions of the link-vs-module family (dec_family); data.ambiguous_with_belief_fallback counts those whose belief labels fell back to hindsight labels
definitions.belief_best_changed: ambiguous decisions whose set {J_belief <= min J_belief + TOL} differs from that at L = 100
definitions.both: decisions with at least one observe and one non-observe candidate
definitions.development: train and val pooled; the test split is never read
definitions.e1: regret (validation) of the flat GBM fitted on belief labels minus that fitted on hindsight labels, both refitted on the L labels of their label set; scored with the L labels of the scoring label set (view <scoring>/<subset>, subsets as train_direct.subsets); 95% paired cluster bootstrap over episodes, 2,000 resamples, seed 0
definitions.e1_fixed: each GBM's grid point fixed to its L = 100 choice
definitions.e1_reselected: each GBM's FLAT_GRID point chosen on val regret under its training labels at that L
definitions.gather_flipped: ambiguous decisions with both whose belief gathering-optimal answer differs from L = 100
definitions.gathering_optimal: among decisions with both: min J over the observe candidates < min J over the non-observe candidates - TOL, under the named label set (scripts/dataset_stats.py, TOL = 1e-9)
definitions.high_stakes: max - min p_trip over the candidates > TOL (dataset_stats; train_direct's max > min gives the same decisions, p_trip being a share of replicates)
definitions.high_stakes_1h: the same with p_trip counting only the primary replicates that tripped within 1 h of tau (y_trip_event, y_trip_time)
definitions.hindsight_best: candidates with hindsight J <= min hindsight J + TOL
definitions.hindsight_best_belief_regret: min J_belief over the hindsight-best candidates minus min J_belief (dataset_stats hindsight_choice_belief_regret); positive: > TOL
definitions.hindsight_best_changed: all decisions whose hindsight-best set differs from that at L = 100
definitions.labels_under_L: J_L = J + (L - 100) p_trip and J_belief_L = J_belief + (L - 100) p_trip_belief per candidate (exact: the lump is charged once per tripped replicate and nothing accrues after a trip); VOI recomputed from J_L
definitions.relative: diff regret point / regret point of the hindsight-trained GBM
definitions.trip_part: regret: L * (p_trip_belief of the hindsight-best candidate with the lowest J_belief - p_trip_belief of the first argmin of J_belief), the rest is non-trip cost; mean J: L * mean p_trip over all candidates
definitions.trips_within_1h_share: primary replicates (train and val) that tripped within 1 h of tau among those that tripped within their label horizon (3 h, shorter where the episode ended first)
